ancientwarriorsloyalguanyun.name: Ancient Warriors - Loyal Guan Yun
ancientwarriorsloyalguanyun.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Your opponent cannot target other "Ancient Warriors" monsters you control with card effects. If your opponent controls more monsters than you do: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Ancient Warriors - Loyal Guan Yun" once per turn.

attackgainer.name: Attack Gainer
attackgainer.desc: If this card is sent to the Graveyard as a Synchro Material Monster, select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. The selected opponent's monster loses 1000 ATK until the End Phase.

barrierstatueoftheinferno.name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
barrierstatueoftheinferno.desc: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters.

battlecruiserdianthus.name: Battlecruiser Dianthus
battlecruiserdianthus.desc:
3 Level 3 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand. You can only use the effect of "Battlecruiser Dianthus" once per turn.

byorderoftheemperor.name: By Order of the Emperor
byorderoftheemperor.desc: When a monster effect is activated that activates when a monster is Normal Summoned: You can negate the activation, then the player whose effect activation was negated draws 1 card.

chaoszone.name: Chaos Zone
chaoszone.desc: Each time a monster(s) is banished, place 1 Chaos Counter on this card for each of those monsters. Once per turn: You can remove 4 or more Chaos Counters from your field, then target 1 banished monster with a Level equal to the number removed; Special Summon that target. When this card on the field is sent to the GY by your opponent's card effect: You can add 1 LIGHT or DARK monster from your Deck to your hand, whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Chaos Counters that were on this card.

chevalierdefleur.name: Chevalier de Fleur
chevalierdefleur.desc:
"Fleur Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Once during each of your turns, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, you can negate the activation and destroy that card.

cosmiccompass.name: Cosmic Compass
cosmiccompass.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon a number of "Compass Tokens" (Machine/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) up to the number of monsters your opponent controls.

darklorddjehuty.name: Darklord Djehuty
darklorddjehuty.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Darklord" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Darklord Djehuty", also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Fairy monsters. If you control a DARK Fairy Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Darklord" card or "Forbidden" Quick-Play Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Darklord Djehuty" once per turn.

dekoichithebattlechantedlocomotive.name: Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive
dekoichithebattlechantedlocomotive.desc: FLIP: Draw 1 card, then draw 1 additional card for each face-up "Bokoichi the Freightening Car" you control.

destinyboard.name: Destiny Board
destinyboard.desc: When this card and all 4 "Spirit Message" cards with different names are placed on your field, you win the Duel. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Place 1 "Spirit Message" card from your hand or Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone face-up, in the proper order of "I", "N", "A", and "L". When any "Spirit Message" card or "Destiny Board" you control leaves the field, send all "Spirit Message" cards and "Destiny Board" you control to the Graveyard.

dirgeofthelostdragon.name: Dirge of the Lost Dragon
dirgeofthelostdragon.desc: Activate this card by declaring 1 card name. Each time the declared card, or its effect, is activated, halve its owner's LP immediately after it resolves. During the End Phase, if this card halved a player's LP this turn, send this card to the GY. While your opponent controls a monster, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

drilldrivervespenato.name: Drill Driver Vespenato
drilldrivervespenato.desc:
2 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Drill Driver Vespenato" by using 1 Rank 4 Xyz Monster you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) This card cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon the turn it was Xyz Summoned. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this Xyz Summoned card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can target 1 Level 5 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Drill Driver Vespenato" once per turn.

fleuretdefleur.name: Fleuret de Fleur
fleuretdefleur.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Level 2 or lower monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also equip it with this card. When this card, equipped by this effect, leaves the field, destroy that monster. The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. If this card is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY: You can equip this card to 1 Synchro Monster you control. You can only use this effect of "Fleuret de Fleur" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Fleuret de Fleur" per turn.

gravicrushdragon.name: Gravi-Crush Dragon
gravicrushdragon.desc: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

hecahandsgodos.name: Hecahands Godos
hecahandsgodos.desc: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hecahands Godos" once per turn. If a card(s) is added to your opponent's hand (except during the Draw Phase or Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field, but banish it when it leaves the field.

hiddensoldiers.name: Hidden Soldiers
hiddensoldiers.desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower DARK monster from your hand.

lavalthegreater.name: Laval the Greater
lavalthegreater.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner FIRE monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If this card would be destroyed by a card effect, you can banish 1 "Laval" monster from your Graveyard instead.

lionalligator.name: Lion Alligator
lionalligator.desc: While you control a Reptile-Type monster (other than this card), if a Reptile-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

madolchelesson.name: Madolche Lesson
madolchelesson.desc: Target 1 "Madolche" monster in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck, and if you do, all "Madolche" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK and DEF, then you can shuffle 1 other monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.

number39utopiadouble.name: Number 39: Utopia Double
number39utopiadouble.desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
(Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Double or Nothing!" from your Deck to your hand, then Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Utopia" Xyz Monster, except "Number 39: Utopia Double", by using this face-up card you control as material, and if you do, its ATK becomes doubled, but it cannot attack directly. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon. Transfer its materials to the Summoned monster.) You can only use this effect of "Number 39: Utopia Double" once per turn.

overfusion.name: Over Fusion
overfusion.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; reveal 1 "Elemental HERO", "Neo-Spacian", or Level 10 monster from your hand, Deck, or Extra Deck, and the targeted monster's name can be treated as the revealed monster's if used as Fusion Material this turn. Send the revealed monster to the GY if you have "Elemental HERO Neos" on your field or in your GY, otherwise shuffle it back into its Deck (if revealed from the hand, shuffle into the Main Deck). You can only activate 1 "Over Fusion" per turn.

performanceofsword.name: Performance of Sword
performanceofsword.desc: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Commencement Dance". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

possesseddestinywynn.name: Possessed Destiny - Wynn
possesseddestinywynn.desc:
1 Spellcaster monster + 1 WIND monster
(This card is always treated as a "Familiar-Possessed" card.)
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can place 1 WIND monster from your GY on the bottom of the Deck, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 2 cards on the field, including a WIND monster you control; place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use 1 "Possessed Destiny - Wynn" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

qlifesend.name: Qlife's End
qlifesend.desc: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 1000). (This card is NOT treated as a Trap Card.) During the turn this card was Summoned this way, "Qli" Spell/Trap Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. If Summoned this way, this card can be treated as 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an "Apoqliphort" monster.

rokketsynchron.name: Rokket Synchron
rokketsynchron.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher DARK Dragon monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Defense Position, negate its effects, destroy it during the End Phase, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters.

speedroidmenko.name: Speedroid Menko
speedroidmenko.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card in Attack Position, and if you do, change all face-up monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position.

synkronresonator.name: Synkron Resonator
synkronresonator.desc: If a Synchro Monster is on the field, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Synkron Resonator" once per turn this way. If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "Resonator" monster in your Graveyard, except "Synkron Resonator"; add it to your hand.

thegraveyardinthefourthdimension.name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
thegraveyardinthefourthdimension.desc: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

tokenfeastevil.name: Token Feastevil
tokenfeastevil.desc: When a Token(s) is Special Summoned: Destroy as many Tokens on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each Token destroyed.

treeotter.name: Tree Otter
treeotter.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You must control a Beast-Type monster (other than this card) to activate and to resolve this effect.

whitedragonwyverburster.name: White Dragon Wyverburster
whitedragonwyverburster.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 DARK monster from your GY. You can only Special Summon "White Dragon Wyverburster" once per turn this way. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Black Dragon Collapserpent" from your Deck to your hand.

xztankcannon.name: XZ-Tank Cannon
xztankcannon.desc:
"X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.
